calculation.description: For each tradable asset, use the negative lagged three-day return, demeaned cross-sectionally. Activate only when the prior-day VIX return is in its trailing 60-day upper quartile and prior cross-asset daily-return dispersion is in its trailing 60-day upper quartile. VIX and dispersion conditions are lagged one day; forward returns are not used in signal construction. Inactive observations are missing rather than zero.

validation.regime_notes: Five-day IC and ICIR pass the benchmark-wide absolute gates of 0.0070 and 0.0840. Five-day validation used 88 dates and average 14.05 valid instruments from the 15-asset universe. Daily-regime checks were mixed: 2020-22 was negative, while 2023-24 and 2025-26 were positive; 2027 YTD had one usable observation and is not reliable. Low activation coverage and small cross-section imply conservative sizing and monitoring. Library correlation is pending deterministic audit.
